description: gateway/messages.json: the words of the gateway's own refusals.

messages.description: Each refusal the gateway makes itself.

code.description: Its `code`, where it carries one: a LimitRefusal's, or the transport code errors/codes.json names for its status.

situation.description: When the gateway answers it, and what fills each `{name}` of its texts.

error.description: Its text. A `{name}` in it is filled with what the row's `situation` names, and nothing else in it varies.

failures.description: Each failure frame the gateway delivers itself, on the stream of the client whose request it answers.

situation.description: When the gateway answers it, and what fills each `{name}` of its texts.

message.description: Its text. A `{name}` in it is filled with what the row's `situation` names, and nothing else in it varies.

noCredential.description: For a request that presents no credential. The challenge. `{origin}` is the origin the Unauthorized response names: `http://` and the request's `Host`, or, for a request that names none, the gateway's `publicUrl`.

refused.description: For a request whose credential, a bearer token or a media token, is refused. The challenge. `{origin}` is the origin the Unauthorized response names: `http://` and the request's `Host`, or, for a request that names none, the gateway's `publicUrl`.
